classification: New primitive source-reading diagnostic, implementer-reviewed. Not a complete lesson, blind classroom benchmark or overall model quality estimate.
findings: The model answers these single questions correctly in meaning in both modes; the earlier compound failures cannot be explained simply as inability to read these basic records. This is an inference limited to these diagnostic questions.
Most answers are longer than the requested minimal phrase. English missing-overlap answers quote the missing-evidence sentence instead of emitting UNKNOWN. Do not treat that as a supplied count.
A deterministic resolver locates the unique legal count within an exact returned source fragment. All eight actual returned/whole responses resolve to the original expected word-form count.
Rewritten values, repeated excerpts, multiple contained counts and unsupported numbers remain review cases. A located quote never establishes its semantic role or teacher approval.
nextAction: Build a bounded sequential atomic-question proposal path, preserving original quotes, owner constraints, partial progress and cancellation. Measure whole-task time and substantive review corrections on new complete inputs before replacing the compound path.
productionStatus: Diagnostic harness and answer resolver have no production caller yet; existing proposal routing unchanged.
